scientific_integrity: A symbolic proof of all equality cases and a separate bounded exhaustive checker are supplied. No stronger novelty, priority, independent validation, or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to labeled crown graphs with n>=5. Prior work already proves the scalar maximum 2n-4 and exhibits an extremal construction through an equivalent total-2-coalition problem on complete bipartite graphs; the new statement is the complete classification, exact count, and coalition graph type. Finite verification does not prove the infinite theorem; possible unindexed overlap remains and no independent audit has occurred.
title: Complete maximum total-coalition partitions of crown graphs
